title: what's using so much memory on this machine right now and how do we kill stale processes or ones we don't need
summary: The biggest memory user isn't a process. About 13 GB of your RAM is files sitting in `/tmp`. Your `/tmp` is a tmpfs, which means everything stored there lives in RAM, and you have no swap. That explains why `free` shows 12 Gi "shared" and only about 3.5 Gi available out of 30 Gi.
